acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, KHYOD KYANG YIN, DNGOS PO DANG 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN YOD PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, de chos can, der thal, khyod kyang yin, dngos po dang 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that the exclusion of all that is not an unchanging thing is such that being it is not contradictory to being something which is such that being it is contradictory to being a working thing.] Suppose you say it's not correct. Consider this same thing. It is so, Because there does exist one thing which is both it, and which is also such that being it is contradictory to being a working thing.
